summary: Rein Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing an underwritten public offering of 50,000,000 common shares at $1.00 per share, with a 45-day overallotment option for 7,500,000 additional shares. Konik Capital Partners acted as sole book-runner. Net proceeds of ~$46.1M after discounts and expenses. The offering was made under an effective S-1. Underwriter received warrants for 3% of shares sold, exercisable at $1.50 for five years, with a 180-day lock-up per FINRA. This is a routine equity capital raise, not a special-situation event.
